summary: Master social commerce and shoppable media. Learn to scale TikTok Shop, Instagram Shopping, and livestream retail with our expert-led 5-day training.
lede: Social commerce training covers how retail, marketing, and digital practitioners operate storefronts and shoppable content across social platforms. It is designed for practitioners and leaders managing retail, technology, and digital engagement, with a focus on connecting product feeds and inventory, planning shoppable video and livestream sales, and coordinating creator-led commerce. The syllabus also covers social CRM and first-party data capture, conversion-focused content, and measuring performance through attribution.
audienceIntro: This intermediate-to-advanced program is designed for practitioners and leaders who manage the intersection of retail, technology, and digital engagement.
audience: Performance Marketing Leads focused on social-to-sale attribution
modules: Social Commerce Foundations and Market Dynamics
Shoppable Media Strategy and Content Engineering
Creator Economy and Social Affiliate Models
Social CRM and First-Party Data Strategy
Global Compliance and Social Commerce Ethics
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3 years of experience in digital marketing, e-commerce, or social media management. Familiarity with Meta Business Suite, TikTok Ads Manager, or Google Analytics 4 is highly recommended. Access to a business-level social media account for practical exercises is preferred but not mandatory.
